acronyms.definition: American Society of Addiction Medicine criteria, if used by the facility/workflow

review_statuses.label: Not Reviewed
review_statuses.description: The item is known to the app but no review has started.

review_statuses.label: Ready for Review
review_statuses.description: Required source material is present enough for reviewer selection.

review_statuses.label: In Review
review_statuses.description: A reviewer or automated deterministic pass is actively evaluating the item.

review_statuses.label: Needs Human Review
review_statuses.description: The app found missing, conflicting, unreadable, or clinically judgment-dependent evidence.

review_statuses.label: Passed
review_statuses.description: The reviewed item satisfied the configured checklist evidence.

review_statuses.label: Failed
review_statuses.description: The reviewed item has confirmed checklist failures.

review_statuses.label: Missing Required Data
review_statuses.description: The app cannot determine compliance because required metadata or evidence is absent.

review_statuses.label: Error
review_statuses.description: A technical or parsing error prevented review completion.

review_statuses.label: Finalized
review_statuses.description: The reviewer completed disposition and the item should not return to unreviewed unless it changes, expires, or is reopened.

loc_change_blocker.message: The treatment-plan update window after a level-of-care change is not confirmed. Keep this configurable and mark LOC-change results as needs human review until validated.

steps.title: Select review source
steps.objective: The reviewer chooses either EMR/API access or manual upload before a treatment plan or clinical note set is evaluated.
checks: Route API and upload items into the same checklist workflow.
finding_examples: Item was created outside the common checklist workflow.
remediation_suggestions: Choose EMR/API access or manual upload and restart the review case.

steps.title: API source discovery
steps.objective: If API access is configured, periodically query the EMR/API, identify available notes and treatment plans, classify review status, and show filtered items needing review.
checks: Do not expose API keys or tokens to the browser.
Show mock/stub discovery when live import is not approved.
remediation_suggestions: Configure API settings, use mock discovery, or upload a local export until live import is approved.

steps.title: Upload source intake
steps.objective: Accept supported files, validate file type and size, extract text where possible, and create a review case using the common checklist workflow.
remediation_suggestions: Upload supported synthetic or exported files and enter the patient identifier when it cannot be detected.

steps.title: Review item status classification
steps.objective: Assign a clear status such as Not Reviewed, Ready for Review, In Review, Needs Human Review, Passed, Failed, Missing Required Data, Error, or Finalized.
checks: Use deterministic Missing Required Data and Needs Human Review states.
finding_examples: Error state has no recovery message.
remediation_suggestions: Reclassify the item and document the reason for the status.

steps.title: Required metadata capture
steps.objective: Capture or extract client identifier, document type, provider or staff, service date, plan date, review period, program/location, and source system or file.
checks: Flag missing admission date, LOC, signature date, and source evidence.
finding_examples: Plan date conflicts with source document date.
remediation_suggestions: Correct metadata in the source export or add reviewer notes that identify the source evidence.

steps.title: Required document set check
steps.objective: Verify whether expected treatment plan, progress notes, assessments, signatures, reviews, and supporting documents are present or missing.
remediation_suggestions: Upload or import the missing document set before final disposition.

steps.title: Treatment plan structure check
steps.objective: Identify problem areas, diagnoses or clinical needs, goals, objectives, interventions, target dates, review dates, staff responsibilities, client participation, and signatures.
checks: Flag missing client or staff signatures.
Flag missing target or review dates.
remediation_suggestions: Update the treatment plan so all required structural sections are explicit.

steps.title: Timeliness check
steps.objective: Check whether the treatment plan was created, reviewed, updated, and signed within the required timeframe and flag expired, late, missing, or future-dated items.
checks: Keep LOC-change window unvalidated until R3 confirms it.
remediation_suggestions: Correct dates, obtain signatures, or document manual review when the LOC-change rule is unresolved.

steps.title: Completeness check
steps.objective: Flag missing sections, blank fields, placeholder text, missing signatures, missing credentials, missing dates, generic language, and incomplete goals/objectives/interventions.
remediation_suggestions: Complete missing fields and replace placeholders with individualized clinical content.

steps.title: Goal/objective quality check
steps.objective: Evaluate whether goals and objectives are individualized and SMART enough to support clinical review.
checks: Flag goals that are not individualized.
remediation_suggestions: Rewrite goals and objectives with individualized, measurable, time-bound language.

steps.title: Medical necessity / clinical rationale check
steps.objective: Check whether diagnosis, symptoms, level of care, risks, needs, and planned services are logically connected.
checks: Flag missing diagnosis or symptom linkage.
Flag services unsupported by documented needs.
finding_examples: Planned service not connected to diagnosis.
LOC not supported by source evidence.
Risk documented with no plan response.
remediation_suggestions: Add clinical rationale that links diagnoses, risks, LOC, and planned services.

steps.title: Progress note alignment check
steps.objective: Check whether progress notes and services connect back to active treatment plan goals, objectives, interventions, frequency, duration, and modality.
checks: Flag billed or documented service not tied to the plan.
finding_examples: Group note does not map to an active objective.
remediation_suggestions: Update progress note linkage or revise the treatment plan before final approval.

steps.title: Consistency check
steps.objective: Flag contradictions across notes and plans, including inconsistent dates, provider names, diagnosis, level of care, service frequency, client identifiers, or plan version.
finding_examples: Service date conflicts with plan date.
remediation_suggestions: Resolve contradictions in the source record or document why one source is authoritative.

steps.title: High-risk issue detection
steps.objective: Specifically flag missing treatment plan, expired plan, unsigned plan, notes before plan creation, billed/documented service not tied to plan, no measurable objective, no progress update, and unsupported service frequency.
checks: Emit a high-risk finding for each configured risk.
Never downgrade high-risk missing data to pass.
remediation_suggestions: Escalate for human review and correct source documentation before finalizing.

steps.title: Evidence capture
steps.objective: For each finding, store a plain-English explanation, severity, checklist step, source document, date, and a short evidence excerpt if safely available.
checks: Do not log uploaded note text.
Avoid PHI in tests, docs, screenshots, and examples.
remediation_suggestions: Add source location, date, severity, and a safe short evidence note.

steps.title: Human review and override
steps.objective: Marleigh or another authorized reviewer can mark findings as confirmed, dismissed, needs follow-up, or corrected, with comments and audit logging.
checks: Require comments for follow-up or dismissal.
Write audit logs without secrets or clinical text.
remediation_suggestions: Record reviewer comment and ensure the audit trail captures the disposition.

steps.title: Output and export
steps.objective: Produce a clear summary with pass/fail/needs-review status, severity counts, finding details, remediation suggestions, and export options such as CSV or JSON as appropriate.
checks: Show a human-readable report in the app.
remediation_suggestions: Use the report/export controls and review exported content before sharing.

steps.title: Status persistence
steps.objective: Save review status so the same note or plan does not appear as unreviewed again unless it changes, expires, or is manually reopened.
checks: Persist status by source item and version.
Reopen on changed source, expiration, or manual action.
remediation_suggestions: Verify item identity, source version, and final disposition are saved.

steps.title: Periodic monitoring
steps.objective: In API mode, periodically refresh note/plan status and surface new, changed, overdue, failed, or needs-review items.
checks: Use mock periodic refresh when live import is disabled.
Show API errors in non-technical language.
Do not retry forever without surfacing errors.
remediation_suggestions: Run a manual refresh, test API connectivity, or use upload mode while API access is unavailable.

steps.title: Audit and traceability
steps.objective: Record when a review was created, by whom, source type, checklist version, app version, model/rules version where applicable, and final disposition.
checks: Write audit events for review creation, findings, override, export, and disposition.
Do not include credentials or uploaded note text in audit details.
remediation_suggestions: Re-run the review or record final disposition with audit logging enabled.
